يخترطن (form VIII)
# يَخْتَرِطْنَ (yaḵtariṭna) /jax.ta.ritˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
# يُخْتَرَطْنَ (yuḵtaraṭna) /jux.ta.ratˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
